blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY — The management of Corazon Locsin Montelibano Memorial Regional Hospital (CLMMRH) here issued a warning on Tuesday, Oct. 13, against the unauthorized use of its official medical certificates, prescription pads, and physicians’ credentials. Dr. Joan E. Cerrada, CLMMRH chief, said in a public advisory that it has come to their attention that fabricated medical certificates and prescription pads bearing the hospital’s name and identifying details are being used by certain individuals to seek financial assistance from the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) and other government agencies.
